As the Alibaba Partnership’s director nomination rights are categorized as a weighted voting rights structure (the “ WVR structure ”) under the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (the “ Hong Kong Listing Rules ”), we are deemed as a company with a WVR structure. The above grant is not subject to approval by the Shareholders in general meeting.
